# State model transitions are labeled as 'structural' confidence only

Rendered state model transitions are always labeled as inferred with 'structural' confidence and never claim proven-exhaustive control-flow analysis.

To prevent overstatement of the precision/guarantees provided by automatically inferred state diagrams.
